mapper.select: /* prodName:标题名(普通产品取产品名称 ,分级产品取 母产品名称+（子产品代码）) */ SELECT CASE WHEN RPI.IS_GRADE = '01' THEN RPI2.PROD_NAME ||'（'||RPI.PROD_ID||'）' ELSE RPI.PROD_NAME END prodName, RPI.SET_DATE setDate, nvl(RPI.MDATE,RPI2.MDATE) mDate FROM REP_PROD_INFO RPI /*查询普通产品或者母产品数据 P_PROD_ID:母产品代码：当为子产品时填写母产品代码。普通产品为自己的产品代码。母产品为空*/ LEFT JOIN REP_PROD_INFO RPI2 ON RPI.P_PROD_ID = RPI2.PROD_ID AND RPI2.STATUS = 'E' WHERE RPI.PROD_ID = #{prodId} AND RPI.STATUS = 'E'

SELECT TO_CHAR(DPP.OPEN_START_DATE,'yyyy/MM/dd') OPEN_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(DPP.OPEN_END_DATE,'yyyy/MM/dd') OPEN_END_DATE, TO_CHAR(DPP.COLLINGOFF_PERIOD,'yyyy/MM/dd') COLLINGOFF_PERIOD, TO_CHAR(DPP.OPERATION_START_DATE,'yyyy/MM/dd') OPERATION_START_DATE FROM REP_PROD_INFO INFO,DIS_PROD_PLAN DPP where DPP.PROD_ID = NVL(INFO.P_PROD_ID,INFO.PROD_ID) AND INFO.STATUS = 'E' and DPP.DATA_STATUS='E' AND INFO.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND DPP.OPERATION_START_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{endDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND DPP.OPERATION_START_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') ORDER BY DPP.OPERATION_START_DATE
